logp.method_description: The lipophilicity (log Po/w) of Ir1-3 was measured by a shake-flask ultraviolet absorptive spectrophotometry method.6 Octanol-saturated water and water-saturated octanol were obtained by mixing octanol and saline. Aliquots of stock solutions of Ir1-3 in octanol-saturated water were mixed with equal volumes of water-saturated octanol. The mixture was shaken at 60 rpm at 25°C to allow for partitioning. After 24 h, the n-octanol and water phases were separated, centrifuged at 3,000 rpm for 10 min, and the supernatant was isolated. The concentration of Ir1-3 in the water phase (Cw) and organic phase (Co) of the detecting solution was determined by UV-vis spectroscopy. The n-octanol/water partition coefficient, namely, log P, was calculated using the following equation: log P = log (Co / Cw)
